{"diagnosis":"From batch 12 onward the source sends status 'SETTLED' where it used to send 'POSTED'. The silver filter `status = 'POSTED'` therefore drops every non-reversed row in batches 12-14. Batch counts support this: batches 1-11 total 3919 rows, of which 3704 are POSTED, and batches 12-14 total 1056 rows, of which 995 are SETTLED. The REVERSED share is about the same before and after (5.5% vs 5.8%), so SETTLED looks like a rename of POSTED. The fix is to accept both statuses in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM raw_transactions
WHERE status IN ('POSTED','SETTLED');"}}
